existing_mechanisms: Center the Hilbert–Schmidt covariance of the translated source; derive a deficit-dependent rank increment directly on the ramified source; choose a rank target from the actual cost of completing a basis; reduce translate cost to (3d_T\log b) and derive (m\mathcal R\le17fa(\log b)^4). Includes a nonadaptive product-of-contractions proof.
excluded_duplicates: A direct or centered greedy spanning lemma, adaptive completion threshold, smaller logarithmic translate budget, or random contraction sampling on the same moment input.

existing_mechanisms: Use the already available CM norm variable rather than squares of rational local scalars in the cancelling theta product. Two cancelling factors at unramified places, three at the ramified place; combine generic coupling and one-copy witnesses to obtain four-copy local sharpness with the same budget as leastValLE_twelve; safe first port pads four copies to twelve.
excluded_duplicates: Reducing the number of cancellation copies by CM norm pairing, exploiting the one-copy spanning witness, or replacing the local four-squares construction by these local CM choices.

existing_mechanisms: A mixed-radius torsion interpolation grid gives a root-of-unity order bound independent of dimension and polynomial degrees at fixed valuation budget. One choice works for every power of a character. Also stronger near-spanning from two moments, retaining the existing translate budget and obtaining (O(b^{-4})) missing dimension.
excluded_duplicates: Multivariable torsion selection by low-cost interpolation grids, one character for the full power chain, or the associated affine rank recurrence.

existing_mechanisms: Replace Pieri-cone real volume/integration/Riemann-sum counting by signed integer-lattice enumeration. Evaluate cycle determinants and the alternating monomial-orbit sum to recover the inverse flag count. Retain Frobenius power packing, use finite quotient residue counts plus an elementary limit. Second change: direct saturation/Smith argument for exceptional local elementary divisors and truncated colength, avoiding auxiliary generators and Nakayama.
excluded_duplicates: Merely proposing a combinatorial Pieri count, signed lattice enumeration, direct saturation of bad Smith directions, or the same threshold colength argument. This directory was added in the head commit and is easy to miss.

existing_mechanisms: Build the invariant-average contract by scaled tensor symmetrization, coefficient operators and an integral orbit trace rather than explicit Schur-algebra/restricted-representation machinery. Obtain exceptional Smith-factor count by a threshold decomposition and low-rank perturbation/principal-submatrix test; turn it directly into a truncated colength certificate.
excluded_duplicates: Replacing the invariant average by integral orbit traces or removing supplementary generators by this Smith-rank test. The average's integral orbit, rather than saturation alone, is essential.

existing_mechanisms: Use the existing Weyl–Fock matrix identity (GH=hI) to prove an integral adjoint directly; replace the specialized tight-frame construction and cardinality estimates. Use paired-conjugate dual norms for arbitrary complex automorphisms. May reduce (n_{\rm aut}h^2LL^*) to (n_{\rm aut}hLL^*) without changing the downstream contract.
excluded_duplicates: Tight-frame removal using inverse Gram duality, the one-hook normalization, or the paired-conjugation adjoint norm argument.

existing_mechanisms: For each short-basis Gram matrix (G), encode a unitary class by columns of (A^{-1}) modulo integral vectors, in (G^{-1}R^r/R^r\simeq R^r/GR^r). Bound the quotient via (|N(\det G)|). Avoid bounded strong approximation and the extra bounded matrix (GX), preserving the exact explicit class-count constant.
excluded_duplicates: A finite-cokernel/residue invariant replacing the auxiliary principal representative in New.Space.card_stdClasses_le.

existing_mechanisms: Replace primitive labels by norm power tests plus one subgroup exclusion; preserve every audited full scalar-order consumer. Exact elementary count, with a union-bound-only implementation option; at least (q^r/(4r)) labels and sufficient condition (f\ge4rL).
excluded_duplicates: Primitive-label weakening by these explicit norm conditions, or replacing the totient bound by this union/count argument while retaining full scalar order.

existing_mechanisms: A one-shell Newton divided-difference method, weighted Gauss valuations and harmonic averaging give dimension/degree-free common exact primitive order with a singly exponential level ceiling. This explicitly resolves a further question of the earlier interpolation proposal.
excluded_duplicates: A new torsion-interpolation note whose only improvement is singly exponential level or all coordinates in one primitive shell, using Newton extraction/harmonic loss.

existing_mechanisms: Replace selected symmetric coset representatives, extended finite summation and finite-support reduction by normalized orbital sections and a primitive-frame projection. Prove an algebraic twisted-coinvariant kernel theorem with a finite translation-difference certificate; complementary frames yield canonical matching and primitive partners for all full-rank Schwartz–Bruhat data.
excluded_duplicates: A normalized orbital integral or canonical coinvariant reformulation of the theta exchange/matched data, including removal of continuity assumptions for algebraic functionals.

Direct smoothed Perron at the far cutoff. Direct ramified-source spanning strengthens missing dimension to (20d/b^4), with a logarithmic-budget sharpness example.
excluded_duplicates: Large-sieve/Fourier auxiliary-prime selection, a far-cutoff contour shift, or direct ramified-source affine rank recurrence.

excluded_duplicates: The same three substitutions, even if constants or presentation differ.

excluded_duplicates: Merely restricting the arithmetic proof to sparse cutoffs, replacing pointwise arithmetic by local averages, or using averaged Gaussian tails for the twist.

Exact count ((q^r-3q^{r/3}+2)/(3r)); weaken the sole full scalar-order consumer to (6^{s+6}); preserve normalization and power robustness. excluded_duplicates: Two-order robust labels, replacing a full tame-order certificate by two surviving prime components, or this complement-mass improvement over witness-mass counting.

excluded_duplicates: Robust-root three-test predicates, the two-prime surviving-order principle, or their Galois/projector transfer.

excluded_duplicates: The analytic quadratic-twist or direct spanning substitutions, even if bundled differently.

Compare one fixed determinant by a signed product formula instead of introducing a rounded global rational normalization. Expose a (150fa\log b) local colength budget and derive (m\mathcal R\le(1+O(1/\log b))fa(\log b)^4).
excluded_duplicates: Exact signed normalization, separating gauge from colength, or improving only these constants using that already-exposed budget.
